description: This file defines constants, documentation, and function declarations related to parsing display configuration options for the Cuttlefish project. It includes display property flags, help text, and function signatures for parsing display configurations from command-line arguments.

methods.name: ParseDisplayConfig
methods.description: Parses a display configuration string into an optional DisplayConfig object, returning a Result indicating success or failure.

methods.name: ParseDisplayConfigsFromArgs
methods.description: Parses a list of command-line arguments to extract multiple display configurations, returning a Result with a vector of DisplayConfig objects.
